veranderings.rede: A Grade 4 reader links 'bek' to an animal's mouth; 'opening' is clearer for the open end of the drum body.

veranderings.na: kort klank. Die klank het nie
veranderings.rede: Earlier in the block 'Dit' and 'hulle' refer to the rattles, so naming the sound makes clear what has no fixed pitch; the protected wording stays intact.

veranderings.voor: watter gevoel die spel by jou wek
veranderings.na: watter gevoel die spel jou gee
veranderings.rede: 'by jou wek' is formal for Grade 4; 'jou gee' is simpler and keeps the protected word 'gevoel'.
